{{Quote|Thousands of years ago, long before my time, there was a large chapter of Jedi Knights located here. The planet was a center of Jedi information and artifacts, which attracted the vicious Sith.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:FotG" />}}
A '''battle''' was fought on the planet [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] between the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]] and the [[Brotherhood of the Sith|Sith]] in [[3996 BBY]], during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. The battle resulted in a massive [[The Force/Legends|Force]] cataclysm that devastated the planet and wiped out its inhabitants.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|The Jedi on Mustafar uncovered a magnificent crystal of unknown origin. It was as tall as a tower, and the Jedi quickly discovered that it was attuned to the Force within them. When news of an impending Sith invasion reached them, they desperately began to experiment with the crystal, hoping to find a way to use it in their defense.|Obi-Wan Kenobi, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:FotG" />}}
The planet [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] was once a lush green world where the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] maintained many [[Jedi enclave (Mustafar)/Legends|temples]] used to cultivate their abilities and train their students.<ref name="LT">{{SonyCite|url=en_US/players/content.vm?page=Lost%20Treasure&resource=features|text=Lost Treasure}}</ref> In 3996 BBY, during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun's]] [[Sith Empire (Exar Kun)/Legends|Sith Empire]],<ref name="TEA" /> the Jedi discovered a magnificent and colossal [[Lava crystal/Legends|crystal]] that was deeply [[Vergence/Legends|connected]] to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. However, the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] soon discovered the existence of the crystal and assembled an army to invade and conquer Mustafar.<ref name="SWG:FotG" />

==The Battle==
{{Quote|The Sith could barely use their powers at all, while the young Jedi in the field could wield more power than ever. But, they hadn't had time to do enough research on the crystal and it's limits, and as the battle went on, it began to crack.|Obi-Wan Kenobi, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:FotG" />}}
[[File:Mustafar_TEA.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Mustafar's hellish appareance after the battle.]]
As the Sith invasion fleet arrived in the [[Mustafar system/Legends|system]], the Jedi decided to use the power of the crystal to battle the Sith As the Sith [[Warship/Legends|warships]] entered Mustafar's atmosphere, the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] began channeling the Force through the crystal while the younger Jedi led the troops in battle. The strategy worked perfectly as the Jedi on the battlefield could use more powers than ever whereas the Sith could barely use theirs.<ref name="SWG:FotG" />

However, as the battle was raging, the crystal suddenly began to crack. Nevertheless, the Jedi Masters refused to stop channeling the Force and the crystal exploded. The result was catastrophic as it sent the planet itself out of its [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] and wiped out all of the Sith and Jedi.<ref name="SWG:FotG" /> Furthermore, the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Lefrani/Legends|Lefrani]] was tugged out of its orbit and entered into a gravitational detente with the gas giant [[Jestefad/Legends|Jestefad]] and Mustafar was caught in the middle of these untenable gravitational forces. Immense tidal stresses roiled the planet's molten core, inundating the crust with lava and decimating all surface life.<ref name="TEA" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Some believe that the Sith Lord, facing certain defeat, somehow corrupted the vulnerable Jedi Masters as they were channeling. The results was catastrophic. Then the crystal exploded, it sent the planet itself out of its orbit and wiped out all of the Sith and Jedi.|Obi-Wan Kenobi, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:FotG" />}}
The battle indeed ended with the sudden death of every belligerents. The only person who survived the explosion of the crystal was Jedi Master [[Erg Krow]], the elder of the masters, who managed to shield himself from some of the destruction. The fatally injured master discovered large shard of the crystal that still contained tremendous power. Clinging onto life, Krow decided to use his last remaining energy using the Force to put a protective shield around the crystal to make sure that no other [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] could never sense its presence. The Jedi finally died from his injuries but he successfully hid the dangerous artifact for millennia.<ref name="SWG:FotG" />

After several thousand years, the shield created by Jedi Master Erg Krow to protect the crystal shard had diminished and attracted the attention of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Vartonis]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a group of spacers guided by the [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]] of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] [[Mission on Mustafar|defeated]] Vartonis and his [[Brotherhood Mortalis]] and finally destroyed the crystal once for all.<ref name="SWG:FotG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle that turned Mustafar into a hellish world was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan]]'' the third expansion pack for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.<ref name="SWG:FotG" /> ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' eventually placed the battle in [[3996 BBY]], during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]].<ref name="TEA" />
